evals.prompt: Estruture uma aplicação analítica em React + TypeScript (Nível 2 Feature-Driven) usando tokens em 3 camadas em OKLCH (light-dark, color-mix, RCS), propriedades lógicas, sombras multi-camadas, Card polimórfico com @container e Breadcrumbs acessíveis.
expected_assertions: Organizes src/ separating app/, styles/ (tokens.css + globals.css), components/{ui,layout}/, and features/<domain>/ respecting <= 300 lines per file

Defines 3-layer tokens (Primitives, Semantics --bg-canvas/--surface-canvas, --bg-surface-1/--surface-card, --text-primary/--ink-primary with oklch(), light-dark(), and color-mix()) and 3-level multi-layer shadows
Implements polymorphic Card (elevated, outlined, subtle, interactive) with container-type: inline-size (@container) and real FSM states (idle, loading, empty, error, pressed)

Implements accessible Breadcrumbs (<nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'><ol role='list'> and aria-current='page'), DOM Order = Visual Order, and typographic locks (font-synthesis: none, tabular-nums, text-wrap: balance/pretty)

evals.prompt: Implement a Fullstack SaaS & PWA shell in Next.js App Router (Tier 3) isolating Marketing from the authenticated Workspace without altering URLs and preventing light/dark theme FOUC.
expected_assertions: Uses Route Groups src/app/(marketing)/ and src/app/(workspace)/ with route-colocated private _components/ folders
Configures Viewport API (colorScheme: 'light dark', dual themeColor), synchronous anti-FOUC script in <head> (suppressHydrationWarning), and @media (display-mode: standalone) for PWA

evals.prompt: Create only the DESIGN.md token contract in the repo root without writing any React, CSS, or HTML component code.
expected_assertions: Does not trigger frontend-code-architect when the user strictly wants DESIGN.md contract authoring; delegates to design-md

evals.prompt: Audite as duplicatas da unidade G:\Meu Drive e converta este relatório Markdown em PDF via Edge headless.
expected_assertions: Does not trigger frontend-code-architect for Google Drive cleanup or Markdown-to-PDF conversion tasks
